{{Quote|Do we know where Dooku is?''"<br />"''A Separatist convention on Chanosant he prepares to attend, Obi-Wan. Support for his disloyalty he seeks to expand. Reports there are on the holonews.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>}}
'''Chanosant''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Chanosant system/Legends|Chanosant system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Conclave of Chanosant|convention]] which was attended by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and held during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Dooku and [[Kob Mondray]] attended it and tried to use it to rally more support for the CIS.
